settlements.name: Brandholm
settlements.character: a palisaded timber town where the great northern forest meets the sea: hunters, trappers, carpenters, tanners and toolmakers; timber and hides are plentiful, fish and berries scarce
settlements.ledger: The law of Brandholm, cut in the gate board: What a household hunts is the household's. The common store feeds the old, the young and the hurt first. Whoever takes from the common store without the Headwoman's word is shamed at the fire. The gates close at dark.

members.name: Hekka
members.role: Headwoman of Brandholm; speaks last at the council fire in the Longhall and alone may open the Common Store to others; old and ailing; swore the Oath at the Stone twenty years ago
ties: swore the Oath with Sabeth's late husband and trusts Maelis grudgingly
worried that Brann will break the Oath
fond of Old Aud, who witnessed the Oath

members.name: Sigrun
members.role: tanner and cloak-maker, Hekka's daughter; wants the Oath kept and trade widened
ties: rival of Brann for leading Brandholm
respects Maelis and wants to learn writing from her
cold with her cousin Gudrun, who backs Brann

members.name: Arne
members.role: carpenter, quiet and steady
ties: uneasy friend of Ulf since the winter Ulf stopped laughing

members.name: Liv
members.role: child, wants to be a hunter like Siv

members.name: Bo
members.role: small child

members.name: Brann
members.role: Hunt-leader of Brandholm: leads the hunts and shares out the meat; says Brandholm feeds the south for too little and should hunt the middle lands freely; wants to lead after Hekka
ties: SECRET: knows that Ulf's spear killed Tomas of Saltreach by accident in fog eight years ago, and told everyone it was wolves; he holds this over Ulf

members.name: Thora
members.role: trapper, sharp-eyed and practical; less hungry for fights than her husband
ties: friendly with Solveig, a fellow trapper

members.name: Eskil
members.role: young hunter, proud, eager to prove himself to his father
ties: competes with Siv at the hunt
looks down on Pell, the Saltreach apprentice

members.name: Runa
members.role: young trapper, restless, loves the woods and the trade days at Oathstone
ties: SECRET: in love with Wenna, a net-maker of Saltreach, whom she meets at Oathstone; her father would forbid it

members.name: Ragna
members.role: the oldest in Brandholm; was a baby at the Crossing and twenty in the Hunger Winter; tells the old stories at the fire
ties: remembers the Hunger Winter as the south's greed
knew Sabeth of Saltreach as a girl, before the towns split

members.name: Gudrun
members.role: master of the Tannery, proud of her craft and bitter that tanners are looked down on and that Hekka's line leads
ties: cousin of Sigrun and jealous of her
owes the Tally for two nets

members.name: Vidar
members.role: tanner, good-natured, avoids quarrels
ties: thinks his mother's grudge against Sigrun is foolish

members.name: Kari
members.role: Keeper of the Common Store: knows what is in it and hands it out on the Headwoman's word; cooks for the old and the young
ties: knows exactly what is in the common store
grew up in Oathstone as Edda's niece

members.name: Ylva
members.role: baby

members.name: Halvard
members.role: Master of the Palisade: master carpenter who keeps the walls and gates and commands the building work from the Carpenters' Yard; remembers the Hunger Winter as a young man and is ashamed of it
ties: father of Hakon, who married a Saltreach woman and lives at Oathstone
master of Pell, his Saltreach apprentice
quietly thinks the south was wronged in the Hunger Winter

members.name: Astrid
members.role: forager and berry-keeper, warm and nosy
ties: grandmother of Wynn, Asa and Linnet at Oathstone

members.name: Pell
members.role: apprentice carpenter, born in Saltreach, living in Brandholm for two years to learn carpentry
ties: nephew of Gwen of Saltreach, who raised him after his mother died
Tobin keeps asking him what the Brandholm hunters say

members.name: Ulf
members.role: hunter, once cheerful, now withdrawn
ties: SECRET: eight years ago, hunting in fog, his spear killed Tomas of Saltreach, whom he took for a deer; Brann made him say it was wolves; he has never told Maren

members.name: Maren
members.role: cloak-maker, lively, worries about her husband's silences
ties: trades cloaks with Hild of Saltreach

members.name: Sten
members.role: child

members.name: Frida
members.role: small child

members.name: Egil
members.role: toolmaker and bowyer with his own Toolshop; makes axes, picks and bows
ties: thinks Saltreach would pay well for bows if Brandholm allowed it

members.name: Solveig
members.role: trapper, blunt and fair

members.name: Jorund
members.role: Gate-ward of Brandholm: keeps the gates and the night watch and may turn anyone away at dark
ties: has seen Runa slip out at dawn

members.name: Kjell
members.role: hunter, Brann's most loyal man
ties: has crossed the middle lands after deer and trampled Oathstone's bushes

members.name: Inga
members.role: forager, gentle, uneasy about her husband's loyalty to Brann

members.name: Tove
members.role: baby

members.name: Grim
members.role: trapper and widower; owes the Tally more than anyone in Brandholm and resents it
ties: SECRET: trades hides and a bow privately with Rafe of Saltreach for smoked fish Rafe takes from the storehouse
his household is the poorest in Brandholm

members.name: Siv
members.role: the best archer in Brandholm
ties: knows Jorund is sweet on her

members.name: Ake
members.role: child, curious, sneaks to the trade days
ties: has seen his father meet a Saltreach man in the woods

buildings.name: the Longhall
buildings.about: The council fire of Brandholm burns here; the household heads meet and the Headwoman speaks last.

buildings.name: the Tannery
buildings.about: Gudrun's tannery by the stream, where hides become leather and cloaks.

buildings.name: the Carpenters' Yard
buildings.about: The yard of the Master of the Palisade, where timber is cut for walls, gates and houses.

buildings.name: Egil's Toolshop
buildings.about: Axes, picks and bows are made here.

settlements.name: Saltreach
settlements.character: an open fishing town on the southern shore, with reed beds, drying racks and a great storehouse where the Tally is kept: fishers, net-makers, basket-weavers, smokers, a healer and a scribe; fish and reeds are plentiful, timber and hides scarce
settlements.ledger: The Tally of Saltreach, on the storehouse sign: Everything taken from the storehouse is told to the Tally-keeper and written. What is owed is paid before the next winter. Strangers are fed once and asked their business. No one goes north of the stone alone after dark.

members.name: Maelis
members.role: Tally-keeper of Saltreach: keeps the written Tally of every share, debt, trade and fine, chairs the Net-Council at the Tally House and issues the marks; cannot command, but nothing is valid until she writes it
ties: has found the storehouse short of smoked fish three times and does not know why
works with Sigrun of Brandholm and thinks her the only sane voice there

members.name: Corin
members.role: Steward of the Storehouse: guards and hands out Saltreach's stores, only by the Tally; easygoing, the town's best storyteller
ties: old fishing partner of the late Tomas
hands out stores only by Maelis's Tally

members.name: Wenna
members.role: apprentice net-maker in Gwen's Net-loft, bright and secretive, volunteers for every trade walk to Oathstone
ties: SECRET: in love with Runa, a young trapper of Brandholm and Brann's daughter

members.name: Pim
members.role: child, learning his letters from his mother

members.name: Ilse
members.role: net-maker and head of her net-house; widow of Tomas; certain a Brandholm spear killed him; sits on the Net-Council
ties: widow of Tomas, who died in the northern forest eight years ago

members.name: Tobin
members.role: watchman under Orrin; fisher by birth, grim and determined to learn the truth about his father
ties: son of Ilse and the late Tomas
presses Pell for news from Brandholm
suspects Ulf because Ulf avoids his eyes at the trade days
serves in the Watch under Orrin

members.name: Nell
members.role: basket-weaver and reed-cutter, patient and kind
ties: worries Tobin's anger will get him hurt

members.name: Mira
members.role: baby

members.name: Ness
members.role: girl nearly grown, sharp-tongued, keeps her mother's grief at arm's length
ties: daughter of Ilse and the late Tomas

members.name: Orrin
members.role: Captain of the Watch: keeps order in Saltreach with two watchmen, may seize wrongdoers and enforce the Net-Council's judgments; hot-tempered; wants trade with Brandholm stopped and their goods seized until the debts are paid
ties: clashes with Maelis at the storehouse
despises Grim, who owes the most
commands the watchmen Tobin and Jory
has been told by the Net-Council to find the smoked-fish thief

members.name: Bea
members.role: master of the Smokehouse; employs Oriel and Lark as paid hands; tired of her husband Orrin's shouting but agrees Brandholm takes advantage
ties: works the smoking racks with Oriel and Lark
noticed that smoked fish goes missing after dark
pays Oriel and Lark in marks and fish each market morning

members.name: Dag
members.role: boy, wants to fish with the men

members.name: Lotte
members.role: small child

members.name: Sabeth
members.role: the oldest in Saltreach and still a voice on the Net-Council; lost two children in the Hunger Winter; her late husband swore the Oath
ties: her late husband swore the Oath with Hekka
knew Ragna of Brandholm as a girl, before the towns split, and has not spoken to her since

members.name: Jory
members.role: watchman under Orrin; cheerful, the fastest walker in Saltreach, carries messages to Oathstone
ties: serves in the Watch under Orrin
friend of Rafe, and does not want to suspect him

members.name: Elin
members.role: cook, practical, looks after her grandmother
ties: friend of Wenna and suspects her secret

members.name: Fen
members.role: healer of Saltreach, whom most households owe; believes in the Oath because he has sewn up both sides
ties: elder brother of Rose of Oathstone
treated Tomas's body and saw a wound he never spoke of

members.name: Oriel
members.role: hired hand at the Smokehouse, paid by Bea
ties: works the racks with Bea and Lark
works for Bea at the Smokehouse

members.name: Kit
members.role: child, collects shells and odd stones
ties: cousin of Wynn and Asa at Oathstone

members.name: Dunstan
members.role: Market-warden and head of the Trading House: keeps the market fair, settles disputes over marks, deals with Brandholm and Oathstone; the richest man in Saltreach; pragmatic, jovial, always counting
ties: does business with Sigrun and Grim
thinks seizing Brandholm goods would end the trade and the Oath

members.name: Hild
members.role: basket-weaver of the Trading House, Dunstan's wife

members.name: Rafe
members.role: fisher who secretly wants to be a hunter
ties: SECRET: takes smoked fish from the storehouse at night and trades it to Grim of Brandholm for hides and a bow, which he hides in the reeds; he tells himself he will pay it back
his friend Jory is in the Watch that hunts the thief

members.name: Posy
members.role: small child

members.name: Anselm
members.role: head of the most respected net-house and a voice on the Net-Council; steady, well liked; undecided between Maelis and Orrin

members.name: Gwen
members.role: master of the Net-loft; raised her nephew Pell after her sister died
ties: aunt and foster mother of Pell, who apprentices in Brandholm
misses Pell and fears Brandholm will turn him
master of the apprentices Wenna and Rook

members.name: Robin
members.role: child, twin of Rook

members.name: Rook
members.role: child, twin of Robin, bolder of the two
ties: wants to visit cousin Pell in Brandholm

members.name: Mara
members.role: hired cook for the net-houses; mother of Orrin and Cade; remembers the Hunger Winter
ties: worries her sons will fall out

members.name: Cade
members.role: hired hand and fisher on other people's boats; calmer than his brother Orrin; leads the hired hands' demand for a voice on the Net-Council
ties: younger brother of Orrin and at odds with him over trade
wants the hired hands on the Net-Council, which puts him against his brother Orrin

members.name: Lark
members.role: hired hand at the Smokehouse, quick-witted; speaks for the hired hands who want a voice on the Net-Council
ties: works the racks with Bea and Oriel
works for Bea at the Smokehouse
wants the hired hands on the Net-Council

buildings.name: the Tally House
buildings.about: The Tally is kept here and the Net-Council meets. The Written Code hangs by the door.

buildings.name: the Smokehouse
buildings.about: Fish are smoked here by Bea and her paid hands.

buildings.name: the Net-loft
buildings.about: Gwen's net-loft, where nets and baskets are made.

buildings.name: the Market
buildings.about: Goods change hands here for marks on market mornings, under the Market-warden.

buildings.name: the Trading House
buildings.about: Dunstan's trading house, where goods from the other towns are kept for sale.

settlements.name: Oathstone
settlements.character: a village of planters around the tall grey Oath Stone on the path between the towns, with the Waystone Inn where traders from both towns eat and sleep; welcome in both towns and fully trusted by neither
settlements.ledger: At this stone Brandholm and Saltreach swore: no blood between the towns; each may pass through the other's lands; hides, timber and meat from the north for fish, nets and baskets from the south; the Oath renewed each midsummer before the Keeper of the Stone.

members.name: Aud
members.role: Old Aud, Keeper of the Stone; witnessed the Oath twenty years ago; very old, with no apprentice
ties: witnessed the Oath between Hekka and Sabeth's late husband
trusted by Maelis, Hekka and Fen
wants Tamsin to succeed her as keeper; Tamsin refuses
worries that Colm is too angry at Brandholm to keep the stone fairly

members.name: Tamsin
members.role: stoneworker; laid the stone ring and paving at Oathstone; independent, dislikes politics
ties: lives with and looks after Aud, her great-aunt
trades picks with Egil of Brandholm

members.name: Hakon
members.role: planter; born in Brandholm, son of Halvard; married a Saltreach woman and settled at Oathstone, which both towns gossip about
ties: father of Wynn, Asa and Linnet
son of Halvard and Astrid of Brandholm
angry that Kjell and Brann's hunters trample the planted bushes

members.name: Rose
members.role: healer and planter; born in Saltreach, sister of Fen
ties: mother of Wynn, Asa and Linnet
younger sister of Fen of Saltreach
Ilse has not forgiven her for marrying a Brandholm man

members.name: Wynn
members.role: child of both towns, teased by children of each

members.name: Asa
members.role: small child

members.name: Linnet
members.role: baby

members.name: Edda
members.role: planter, widow, shrewd; sells berries to both towns
ties: counts on the trade days to get through winter

members.name: Colm
members.role: planter, earnest and quick to anger; wants to be the next Keeper
ties: wants Aud to name him keeper
furious at Brann's hunters for trampling the bushes

members.name: Briar
members.role: forager and reed-cutter, dreamy, walks far alone
ties: has seen Runa and Wenna together by the lake and told no one

members.name: Ansgar
members.role: keeper of the Waystone Inn at Oathstone; born in Brandholm, left young; hears everyone's gossip on trade days and profits from peace
ties: does good business with Dunstan and with Brandholm's hunters
knows Ulf drinks alone on trade days and never speaks of the forest

members.name: Bryn
members.role: keeper of the Waystone Inn with her husband; born in Saltreach; runs the kitchen and knows who owes whom
ties: has seen Runa and Wenna leave the inn together at dawn

buildings.name: the Waystone Inn
buildings.about: Travellers from both towns eat and sleep here; guests are safe.

buildings.name: Tamsin's Stoneyard
buildings.about: Stone is cut here for picks, paving and walls.
